lines.text: Hangs upon mine eyes: let me rest.
lines.plainText: Hangs upon mine eyes let me rest

lines.text: A pillow for his head:
lines.plainText: A pillow for his head

lines.text: So, leave him all. Well, my companion friends,
lines.plainText: So leave him all Well my companion friends

lines.text: If this but answer to my just belief,
lines.plainText: If this but answer to my just belief

lines.text: I'll well remember you.
lines.plainText: I'll well remember you

content.text: Diana appears to Pericles as in a vision.

lines.text: My temple stands in Ephesus: hie thee thither,
lines.plainText: My temple stands in Ephesus hie thee thither

lines.text: And do upon mine altar sacrifice.
lines.plainText: And do upon mine altar sacrifice

lines.text: There, when my maiden priests are met together,
lines.plainText: There when my maiden priests are met together

lines.text: Before the people all,
lines.plainText: Before the people all

lines.text: Reveal how thou at sea didst lose thy wife:
lines.plainText: Reveal how thou at sea didst lose thy wife

lines.text: To mourn thy crosses, with thy daughter's, call
lines.plainText: To mourn thy crosses with thy daughter's call

lines.text: And give them repetition to the life.
lines.plainText: And give them repetition to the life

lines.text: Or perform my bidding, or thou livest in woe:
lines.plainText: Or perform my bidding or thou livest in woe

lines.text: Do it, and happy; by my silver bow!
lines.plainText: Do it and happy by my silver bow

lines.text: Awake and tell thy dream.
lines.plainText: Awake and tell thy dream

lines.text: Celestial Dian, goddess argentine,
lines.plainText: Celestial Dian goddess argentine

lines.text: I will obey thee. Helicanus!
lines.plainText: I will obey thee Helicanus

lines.text: Sir?
lines.plainText: Sir

lines.text: My purpose was for Tarsus, there to strike
lines.plainText: My purpose was for Tarsus there to strike

lines.text: The inhospitable Cleon; but I am
lines.plainText: The inhospitable Cleon but I am

lines.text: For other service first: toward Ephesus
lines.plainText: For other service first toward Ephesus

lines.text: Turn our blown sails; eftsoons I'll tell thee why.
lines.plainText: Turn our blown sails eftsoons I'll tell thee why

lines.text: [To Lysimachus.] Shall we refresh us, sir, upon your shore,

lines.text: And give you gold for such provision
lines.plainText: And give you gold for such provision

lines.text: As our intents will need?
lines.plainText: As our intents will need

lines.text: Sir, with all my heart,
lines.plainText: Sir with all my heart

lines.text: And when you come ashore I have another suit.
lines.plainText: And when you come ashore I have another suit

lines.text: You shall prevail, were it to woo my daughter;
lines.plainText: You shall prevail were it to woo my daughter
